title: MINIDUMP's StreamDirectoryRva points to the stream directory
summary: NumberOfStreams determines the number of directory entries; each directory entry locates the corresponding stream via a type and position descriptor.
applies: Windows MINIDUMP; static interpretation of acquired dump
detail: Thread lists, module lists, and memory streams are different sources of information. The existing module list does not guarantee that the module content of every page has been collected.
boundary: When a thin dump lacks a section of memory, it can only be said that there is no corresponding collection data, and the original bytes of the page cannot be restored.
relevance: Distinguish between reports that addresses exist, metadata in the stream directory, and actual memory bytes.
